 Hilary Swank, 52, defends pregnancy, says it's 'normal' to have children later in life
 Caroline Gaspich, Demetria Osei-Tutu Updated 2026년 11월 17일 화 오후 10:51 UTC 0 Hilary Swank is pregnant with her third child (Image: Christopher Polk/NBC via Getty I) Oscar-winning actress Hilary Swank has defended her decision to have children later in life after facing criticism following her pregnancy announcement.
 The 52-year-old actress is currently pregnant with her third baby with her husband Philip Schneider. The Million Dollar Baby star shared the news on October 15, 2026, via an Instagram video with her husband and three-year-old twins.
 The playful announcement featured the happy family dancing with glow sticks outlining a baby bump. After receiving comments criticizing her age, Hilary candidly spoke about being a "geriatric mother" during an appearance on This Morning on Tuesday, November 17.
 Yellowjackets fans have a theory about Hilary Swank's character in season 3 
 Hilary Swank is finding motherhood 'exhausting but ecstatic' after twin arrival 
 "It's time to get with the times! We're so advanced in our world, people are living so much longer, and so many women are wanting to wait until later; it's becoming quite a normal thing to have children later," Hilary said to Ben Shephard and Cat Deeley.
 Hilary appeared on ITV's This Morning (Image: Ken McKay/ITV/Shutterstock) Hilary continued reflecting on her current pregnancy, saying it's "much easier" to carry a single baby than twins. She detailed how she worked up until her third trimester with her twins, calling it "a lot."
 The Yellow Jackets actress added, "I was working 18-hour days, and I had two body doubles because they couldn't work overtime. But the pregnant, geriatric lady could."
 Hilary remarked that she feels "blessed" to be a working actor and a mother. She elaborated on how her career was, at one point, a "baby of mine," and she wanted to give it without "distractions."
 Advertisement
 She reiterated that she is so "blessed" and "grateful" to now have both, and she loves it"more than anything."
 "I pinch myself, I really really do, and I wake up with such gratitude at the opportunity to do it and wake up with the gratitude that I now have life again. And I have my two children, I have a wonderful husband, I have a great family, support... I really am blessed, and I couldn't be happier," the film producer continued.
 Hilary Swank said she feels 'blessed' and 'couldn't be happier' (Image: hilaryswank/Instagram) Hilary welcomed her fraternal twins, a daughter named Aya and a son named Ohm, in April 2023 at age 48. She shares her twins and current unborn child with social venture entrepreneur Phillip Schneider.
 The couple first met on a blind date in 2016 and tied the knot in August 2018 in the redwoods of Carmel, California .
 When asked about how her kids feel about their family growing, Hilary said that they are over the moon to have another sibling.
 She shared, "They're so excited about this baby! They keep saying, 'When's the baby coming? When's the baby coming?' And I say, "Christmas time," and they wake up each morning saying 'Is it Christmas yet?' They're so excited."
